core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aasima represents the feminine Arabic form عاصمة (ʿāṣimah), associated with protecting or safeguarding; عاصمة also means “capital city” in modern Arabic.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The Arabic form عاصمة is feminine and is associated with protection/safeguarding; it is also the ordinary modern Arabic word for a capital city. For a personal name, the intended sense should not be reduced to “capital city” alone. The Latin spelling Aasima and Urdu name spelling عاصمہ may vary from the exact Arabic lexical form عاصمة.

etymology.morphology: Feminine active-participle form corresponding to عاصم (ʿāṣim), associated with protection; عاصمة also has the lexical sense “capital city”.
etymology.etymology_explanation: Arabic عاصمة (ʿāṣimah) is associated with the root ع ص م (ʿ-ṣ-m), related to protection and safeguarding. It also means “capital city” in modern Arabic, a distinct contextual sense.
